meta.name: screen-reader-testing
meta.description: Test web applications with screen readers including VoiceOver, NVDA, and JAWS. Use when validating screen reader compatibility, debugging accessibility issues, or ensuring assistive technology support.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 测试网页对读屏软件的兼容性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在测试网站的无障碍支持，需要验证读屏兼容性。
copy.tagline_en: Test web compatibility with screen readers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure your web app works with screen readers.

howto.what: 让 Claude 按屏幕阅读器(VoiceOver、NVDA 等)的快捷键和检查清单,带你逐项验证网页:标题、表单标签、错误提示、弹窗焦点等是否被正确朗读,并给出对应的 ARIA 修改代码。
howto.when: 当你要验证网页的屏幕阅读器兼容性、调试辅助技术的朗读问题,或检查 ARIA 实现时触发。

say.text: 用 NVDA 帮我检查这个表单页,标签和错误提示能读出来吗
say.note: 按 NVDA 脚本逐项过表单与报错

say.text: 帮我看看这个弹窗的焦点管理对不对,关闭后焦点能回去吗
VoiceOver 读不出这个按钮的用途,给我改法
say.note: 给出 aria-label 等修改建议

howto.what_en: Claude walks you through testing a web app with screen readers (VoiceOver, NVDA, JAWS), using their shortcuts and checklists to verify titles, form labels, error messages and modal focus, then suggests ARIA fixes.
howto.when_en: Use when validating screen reader compatibility, debugging assistive technology issues, or checking ARIA implementations.

say_en.text: Check this form page with NVDA — are labels and errors read out?
say_en.note: Walks through the NVDA form test script

say_en.text: Is this modal's focus handled right — does focus return on close?
VoiceOver doesn't announce this button's purpose — how do I fix it?
